race.comment: SKJALDMO (7) is the one to beat after leading throughout to win a maiden at Ballarat by a length as odds-on favourite. The move into BM62 grade is obviously tougher but she is lightly raced, returns off a five-week let-up and gets a 4kg claim to help her carry the step. KILLIANA (1) is the proven sprinter, having fought hard to win at Swan Hill and boasting a strong 1000m record, though this is slightly harder company than that country win. GUNZ (3) was sound first-up when fourth on heavy ground at Ballarat and has reliable wet-track and distance credentials, with his Caulfield Open run last campaign giving his profile some depth. FLYING AWASITA (6) resumes after eight months, won a Wodonga trial and did score on debut this trip. Watch betting.
